The '''Ethnic Architectural Forms of the Tion Hegemony''' was a publication written on the [[Architect/Legends|architectural]] trends of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] cultures of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]. It included a section on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], which covered the planet's tradition of using nature in its architecture. It also mentioned the floorpits that the [[Liann]]s used in most rooms.
